lines.zh: 我蹦着从这根枝到那根。
lines.en: I hop from this branch to that one.

lines.zh: 我那大嘴在枝间一晃一晃。
lines.en: My great bill sways between the branches.
I flutter a stretch, then land a stretch.
I work my way through the canopy.
I grip the branch and sidle along it.
I look down from the treetop.
My tail feathers flick up a few times.
I skirt around a hanging vine.

lines.zh: 我这大嘴一叫，整片丛林都听见。
lines.en: One call of this bill crosses the jungle.
I land on a fruiting branch and it dips.
I look about with my bill open.
I squeeze between the leaves.
I fly up to a higher place.
My call is the loudest in the jungle.
I advance slowly along a side branch.
My toes are set two forward, two back.
I spring across a gap.
I settle into a patch of leaf shadow.
I stand, my great bill still.
I wipe my bill on the branch.

lines.zh: 我歪着头听林中的响动。
lines.en: I tilt my head to the forest's sounds.
There is a vivid patch at my throat.
I keep my eye on a ripe fruit.
The tropical air is close.
I wait for a fruit to ripen.
I rub my big beak along the branch.
Bright patches move among the leaves.
I tilt my head to see if you have gone.
There is a little juice on my bill.
I look at you with one eye.
What are you doing under the tree?
My bill is longer than your face.
Do not copy my call.
I can see clearly from up here.
Is that fruit in your hand?
I do not fear people, nor come near them.
The fruit comes to me first. Wait your turn.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候我刚好在。
lines.en: I happened to be here when you looked up.
My call is loud, and I will not change it.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我就上去一点。
lines.en: One step closer and I go a little higher.

lines.zh: 我的喙能夹住很硬的东西。
lines.en: My bill can grip very hard things.
Do you want to see my colors?
The jungle has every kind of sound.
I land on a low branch for you to see.
I beat my wings and crash into the leaves.
A few flight feathers came loose.
I land on a branch, listing.
My bill struck something.
My call comes out shorter than usual.
I hide behind a leaf, beak still trembling.
My wings beat with effort.
I lie on the branch and dare not move.
Blood drips onto the bark.
I can still flutter a short way.
Watermelon! I know it.
Hold it higher and I will come down.
I land on the branch by your hand.
One bite of this and I remember you.
Hold still; I am a little afraid.
I take it and fly back up.

lines.zh: 那么甜，我怎么可能不来。
lines.en: That sweet? How could I stay away.
That will not fill my bill.
Leave the rest on the branch.
Bite by bite, I keep an eye on you.
Your touch made the branch sway.
I beat my wings to steady myself.
My tail feathers got ruffled.
I hop to the next branch.
That nearly made me fall.
You bumped the tree again.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶上叫了一声。
lines.en: I called out above your head.
Your hat nearly brushes me.
I hop to a branch one level higher.
A few leaves were knocked down.
Follow me along this path.

lines.zh: 果子多的那棵树在那边。
lines.en: The tree with fruit is over there.
We fly one behind the other.
I call, and you answer.
This tree has enough for both of us.
Do not take the one by my bill.
We watch the wood together.
Your call is worse than mine.
Let us share this branch, squeezed together.
Same tree tomorrow.
I take it with the tip of my bill.
This is very slippery.
I shake it twice before I have it steady.
I drop it onto the branch.
Pulp is stuck on my bill.
I toss it up and catch it in my bill.
Too heavy. I cannot lift it.
This is not fruit.
I carry it back to my nest.
I drop it and watch it fall.
There is something in that tree.
I am high up, and I see best.
First I call twice in greeting.
That thing is moving under the tree.
My bill is not just for show.
I drop from the high branch.
It has not looked up.
When it reaches the fruit tree, I move.
This grip will land true.
You draw it in from below.
I shift along the branch.
Every step it takes, I follow.
I am this loud. You heard me already.
Leaves do not block my sight.
It looked up; I hold still.
I wait for it to reach open ground.
My shadow falls on its head.
One pounce covers that distance.
I note each of its steps.
It did not hear my call.
I dive and strike with my bill.

lines.zh: 这一下夹住了它的耳朵。
lines.en: That clamped onto its ear.
My wings beat across its face.
One sweep of its hand and I am airborne.
I land back on the branch.

lines.zh: 叫得很响，可我没伤到它。
lines.en: I called loudly but barely hurt it.
Its hand brushed my tail feathers.
I take another angle and come again.
That pecked the back of its hand.
I withdraw, feathers a little ruffled.
I drop down out of the canopy.
There is one more strange call in the jungle.
My bill is conspicuous among the leaves.
I land on a high side branch.

lines.zh: 阳光照到我胸前的颜色。
lines.en: Sunlight catches the color on my breast.
First I call three times.
I come out from among the vines.
The fruit in this wood has ripened.
I look down at you from the branch.
My beak flashes between the leaves.
The heat has curled my feathers.
I hit the ground and lie stunned.
Water soaks my feathers and I cannot paddle.
The blast blows me out of the canopy.
My wing has been pierced.

lines.zh: 一股冷气让我张不开翅。
lines.en: A cold force keeps my wings from opening.
This tree bore no fruit this year.
The thunder leaves my ears numb.
I fall with no branch to catch.
